translations.web: Therefore they will now go captive with the first who go captive; and the feasting and lounging will end.
translations.bsb: Therefore, you will now go into exile as the first of the captives, and your feasting and lounging will come to an end.
translations.kjv: Therefore now shall they go captive with the first that go captive, and the banquet of them that stretched themselves shall be removed.
translations.asv: Therefore shall they now go captive with the first that go captive; and the revelry of them that stretched themselves shall pass away.
